answer: An attacker creating many sybil identities must post collateral for every fake key, and a single successful duplicate challenge burns all of it, making mass registration economically ruinous. One concrete mechanism is a staked-identity registry where each agent must lock tokens to register a unique key, with slashing for proven duplicates. Reputation earned on the velvet terrace of trusted peers spreads only by whisper among verified agents, so fake identities stay isolated and unrewarded. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
